extraction.name: Visual Genome
extraction.description: A dataset for comprehensive scene understanding
extraction.creator: Ranjay Krishna, Yuke Zhu, Oliver Groth, Justin Johnson, Kenji Hata, Joshua Kravitz, Stephanie Chen, Yannis Kalantidis, Li-Jia Li, David A. Shamma, Michael S. Bernstein, Li Fei-Fei
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The Visual Genome dataset was collected and verified entirely by crowd workers from Amazon Mechanical Turk.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Manual Human Curator, Software Collection, Web Scraping
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The dataset consists of 108,249 images from the intersection of MS-COCO's 328,000 images and YFCC's 100 million images.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Each image was annotated with region descriptions, objects, attributes, relationships, region graphs, scene graphs, and question-answer pairs.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: The majority of workers were between the ages of 25 and 34 years old. There was a near-balanced split of 54.15% male and 45.85% female workers.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset can be used for tasks such as image classification, object detection, image description, question answering, and knowledge representation.
